enso.index: Oceanic Nino Index (NOAA CPC, ERSST v6)

volume.note: shortfall in metres of water table x the mandal's specific yield x its area; specific yield is the CGWB measurement where one exists for that mandal, otherwise the documented aquifer proxy

recharge.rule: May-to-2026-10 change against the same mandal's median over the previous 10 years; flagged short at >= 1.0 m AND >= 2.0x its own year-to-year spread

banked.method: Water-table fluctuation (GEC-2015), the method the official assessment uses: the rise since May times the mandal's specific yield times its area. Net of the season's own pumping, so gross recharge is larger, and a mandal whose table fell counts as zero. The rain counted is June to September.

rainfall.product: CHIRPS v3.0 monthly, 0.05 degrees, mandal mean

afterElNino.rule: June-September rain in the year after a winter whose OND ONI was 0.5 or more
